proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.item_proximity
proposed_widenings.justification: The activation is gated by being within 5 feet of the item, which the current activation/equipment predicate vocabulary cannot encode.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a Magic action..."

proposed_widenings.name: SpawnedCreaturePlacement.nearest_unoccupied_space_to_item
proposed_widenings.justification: The summon location is anchored to the item and chooses the nearest valid space, not a generic self/point range.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible..."

proposed_widenings.name: SpawnedCreatureCatalogRefOverride.understands_caster_languages
proposed_widenings.justification: Catalog-ref summoned creatures currently cannot carry this language-comprehension override from the item text.

notes: Authored as a spawned-creature magic item following the existing air/earth elemental control item pattern. The current surface also forces conservative placeholders for unspecified command range/default behavior.
